Name: RUNTIME_SOUND_GLOBAL_PARAM_ST
Description: Global Wwise sound parameters set at runtime: each row names an RTPC and the value range that is mapped onto it.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the network test build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the retail build.

Fields.Name: RTPC ID
Fields.Description: Name of the Wwise RTPC (real-time parameter control) that this row sets.

Fields.Name: RTPC Minimum Value
Fields.Description: Minimum value of the RTPC. Values from the minimum to the maximum are mapped onto 0-100.

Fields.Name: RTPC Maximum Value
Fields.Description: Maximum value of the RTPC. Values from the minimum to the maximum are mapped onto 0-100.
